content:
Overview

Utsunomiya is a city in Tochigi with a population of 519,000. Famous for its gyoza dumplings, this northern Kanto city offers affordable living and access to Nikko’s World Heritage sites. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
